added_lines: . prayer for vocations! heavenly father, you call each of us by name and invite us to follow your son with generous hearts. pour out your holy spirit upon our diocese of kerry, that young people may encounter christ and have the courage to answer your call. raise up holy priests to proclaim your word, celebrate the eucharist with joy, and serve your people with humble love. strengthen those already called to be faithful witnesses to the gospel. through the prayers of mary, mother of the church, and st brendan, our patron saint, bless our diocese with joyful and generous vocations to the priesthood, for the glory of your name and the life of the world. we ask this through christ our lord . amen. valentia
